
            <h1 class="postTitle">

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">记一次 .NET 某智慧医保云服务Linux 非托管泄露分析</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一背景">一：背景</h2>
<h3 id="1-讲故事">1. 讲故事</h3>
<p>说来也奇怪，最近分析了好几例内存暴涨事故，这不又来了，哈哈，今天再给大家带来一份非托管内存泄露导致的程序生产故障，而且是部署在Linux上.NET程序。</p>
<p>前些天有位朋友找到我，自己有一定的分析能力，发现程序是非托管内存泄露，但能力有限暂时也不知道怎么弄，让我帮忙看下，把dump也丢给我了，既然dump有了，那就开始分析吧。</p>
<h2 id="二内存暴涨分析">二：内存暴涨分析</h2>
<h3 id="1-为什么会暴涨">1. 为什么会暴涨</h3>
<p>虽然朋友说了是非托管内存泄露，但我们还是要相信数据，使用 <code>!maddress</code> 观察即可。</p>
<pre><code class="language-C#">
0:000&gt; !maddress
 +-------------------------------------------------------------------------+ 
 | Memory Type            |          Count |         Size |   Size (bytes) | 
 +-------------------------------------------------------------------------+ 
 | PAGE_READWRITE         |          2,465 |       3.64gb |  3,913,596,928 | 
 | GCHeap                 |              9 |       1.45gb |  1,557,557,248 | 
 | Stack                  |             63 |     972.26mb |  1,019,490,304 | 
 | Image                  |          1,413 |     287.81mb |    301,786,112 | 
 | HighFrequencyHeap      |          1,722 |     107.54mb |    112,758,784 | 
 | LowFrequencyHeap       |            903 |      66.32mb |     69,545,984 | 
 | LoaderCodeHeap         |             35 |      61.00mb |     63,963,136 | 
 | HostCodeHeap           |             85 |      19.97mb |     20,942,848 | 
 | ResolveHeap            |              3 |       1.09mb |      1,142,784 | 
 | IndirectionCellHeap    |              9 |     536.00kb |        548,864 | 
 | StubHeap               |              8 |     460.00kb |        471,040 | 
 | DispatchHeap           |              2 |     452.00kb |        462,848 | 
 | CacheEntryHeap         |              7 |     420.00kb |        430,080 | 
 | LookupHeap             |              5 |     272.00kb |        278,528 | 
 | PAGE_READONLY          |            125 |     263.00kb |        269,312 | 
 | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY |              6 |     232.00kb |        237,568 | 
 | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ      |              2 |       8.00kb |          8,192 | 
 +-------------------------------------------------------------------------+ 
 | [TOTAL]                |          6,862 |       6.58gb |  7,063,490,560 | 
 +-------------------------------------------------------------------------+ 

</code></pre>
<p>从卦中我们看到程序总计吃了 <code>6.58G</code> 内存，其中 <code>PAGE_READWRITE = 3.64G</code>，很显然这是赤裸裸的非托管内存泄露，说实话Linux上的非托管内存泄露不是很好弄，接下来我们的研究方向在哪里呢？</p>
<p>在如今AI横行的时代，可以用一个小技巧，那就是用AI将 2465个 PAGE_READWRITE 做一个 groupby 操作，寻找size的特征，这里取 top5 的记录，截图如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/214741/202607/214741-20260720084640920-224798177.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>从卦中可以清晰的看到，主体上是被 <code>50~200MB</code> 这个区间吃掉了，接下来我们随便挑选几个观察其中内容，截图如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/214741/202607/214741-20260720084917275-459426021.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>从卦中可以看到大量的 <code>lambda_methodxxx</code> 的字样，看起来和动态代码生成有关系，但还不是那么清晰。</p>
<h3 id="2-lambda_method-为啥这么多">2. lambda_method 为啥这么多</h3>
<p>不管怎么说，数字这么大了，冥冥之中应该是一种失控，熟悉C# 的朋友应该知道这个应该是 C# 通过 DynamicMethod 类似的机制动态生成的方法，所以我们的接下来的注意力应该投向托管堆了，使用 <code>!dumpheap -stat</code> 观察托管堆。</p>
<pre><code class="language-C#">
0:000&gt; !dumpheap -stat
...
7f6cee5e6360   105,288  10,949,952 System.Reflection.RuntimeMethodInfo
7f6cf0943da8    81,261  11,701,584 System.Reflection.Emit.DynamicILGenerator
7f6cfc273e40     1,428  11,732,448 IndexItem[]
7f6cf883b510    13,189  12,785,440 System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentDictionary&lt;System.String, System.Object&gt;+Node[]
7f6cf9c3aaa0   132,063  13,734,552 OracleInternal.Common.ColumnDescribeInfo
7f6cfa1f54b0    20,424  16,314,756 Oracle.ManagedDataAccess.Client.OracleParameterStatus[]
7f6cf97f7cb8    55,844  28,145,376 Oracle.ManagedDataAccess.Client.OracleConnection
7f6ceed94548    21,310  32,195,096 System.Byte[][]
7f6cedb852a8 1,445,516  34,692,384 System.Object
7f6cff21ea98   728,162  40,777,072 SkiaSharp.SKString
7f6cf561ca90 1,343,650  42,996,800 Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles.SafeEvpCipherCtxHandle
7f6cedb8b110   144,685  54,552,728 System.Object[]
7f6cf0cd1110 1,878,511  60,112,352 Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles.SafeWaitHandle
55ad23d21ab0    58,648  70,742,904 Free
7f6cedc38080   141,177 100,202,360 System.Int32[]
7f6cedc3d2e0 2,827,739 188,196,546 System.String
7f6cee5ea3a0 3,787,714 280,567,631 System.Byte[]
Total 18,171,140 objects, 1,533,484,720 bytes

Fragmented blocks larger than 0.5 MB:
         Address           Size      Followed By
    7f6a1d47cb18      3,359,344     7f6a1d7b0d88 System.Byte[]
    7f6a1d81c080      1,151,408     7f6a1d935230 System.IO.Compression.ZLibNative+ZLibStreamHandle

</code></pre>
<p>看到卦中的 <code>DynamicILGenerator=10.5w</code> 的时候，猜想再次被印证，看样子非托管内存中都是它投放的，接下来观察 <code>DynamicILGenerator</code> 的引用根看看到底咋回事。</p>
<pre><code class="language-C#">
0:000&gt; !dumpheap -mt 7f6cf0943da8
         Address               MT           Size
         ...
    7f6cc7f7a3f0     7f6cf0943da8            144 
    7f6cc7f81168     7f6cf0943da8            144 
    7f6cc7f81598     7f6cf0943da8            144 
    7f6cc7f81988     7f6cf0943da8            144 
    7f6cc7f83308     7f6cf0943da8            144 
    7f6cc7f83ff8     7f6cf0943da8            144 
    7f6cc7f8ceb8     7f6cf0943da8            144 

Statistics:
          MT  Count  TotalSize Class Name
7f6cf0943da8 81,261 11,701,584 System.Reflection.Emit.DynamicILGenerator
Total 81,261 objects, 11,701,584 bytes

0:000&gt; !gcroot 7f6cc7f7a3f0
Found 0 unique roots.
0:000&gt; !gcroot  7f6b67d00990
Found 0 unique roots.
0:000&gt; !gcroot 7f6cc7f83ff8
Found 0 unique roots.

</code></pre>
<p>从卦中看，比较奇怪的是为什么这几个 DynamicILGenerator 样本都没有引用根呢？这里又藏了什么玄机呢？</p>
<h3 id="3-dynamicilgenerator为什么无引用根">3. DynamicILGenerator为什么无引用根</h3>
<p>如果你有大量的dump分析经验，我相信你马上就会想到一个东西，对，它就是 finalizequeue，因为有析构但未被回收自然就想到了它，输出如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-C#">
0:000&gt; !fq -stat
SyncBlocks to be cleaned up: 0
Free-Threaded Interfaces to be released: 0
MTA Interfaces to be released: 0
STA Interfaces to be released: 0
----------------------------------

Heap 0
generation 0 has 25 objects (7f6b29d58238-&gt;7f6b29d58300)
generation 1 has 90,693 objects (7f6b29ca7010-&gt;7f6b29d58238)
generation 2 has 0 objects (7f6b29ca7010-&gt;7f6b29ca7010)
Ready for finalization 4,088,657 objects (7f6b29d58488-&gt;7f6b2bc89f10)
------------------------------
Statistics for all finalizable objects (including all objects ready for finalization):

</code></pre>
<p>这一卦真的太灵验了，从尼玛 <code>Ready for finalization 4,088,657 objects</code> 中发现有 408w 的对象在freachable中等待释放，看样子FinalizerThread 有点麻烦了。</p>
<h3 id="4-finalizerthread-怎么了">4. FinalizerThread 怎么了</h3>
<p>不管怎么说，直觉告诉我马上就要真相大白了，有点抑制不住内心的喜悦，接下来切过去观察 <code>FinalizerThread</code> 的调用栈，输出如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-C#">
0:000&gt; ~~[11d83]s
libpthread_2_17+0xbde2:
00007f6d`6816ede2 4989c6          mov     r14,rax
0:005&gt; k
 # Child-SP          RetAddr               Call Site
00 00007f6d`644892e0 00007f6d`67143fd6     libpthread_2_17+0xbde2
01 00007f6d`64489330 00007f6d`67143ca1     libcoreclr!CorUnix::CPalSynchronizationManager::ThreadNativeWait+0x126 [/__w/1/s/src/coreclr/pal/src/synchmgr/synchmanager.cpp @ 488] 
02 00007f6d`64489390 00007f6d`67148e39     libcoreclr!CorUnix::CPalSynchronizationManager::BlockThread+0x1d1 [/__w/1/s/src/coreclr/pal/src/synchmgr/synchmanager.cpp @ 307] 
03 (Inline Function) --------`--------     libcoreclr!CorUnix::InternalSleepEx+0x61 [/__w/1/s/src/coreclr/pal/src/synchmgr/wait.cpp @ 850]

0a 00007f6d`64489700 00007f6d`66df1dee     libcoreclr!CallDescrWorkerInternal+0x7c [/__w/1/s/src/coreclr/pal/inc/unixasmmacrosamd64.inc @ 854] 
0b (Inline Function) --------`--------     libcoreclr!CallDescrWorkerWithHandler+0x59 [/__w/1/s/src/coreclr/vm/callhelpers.cpp @ 67] 
0c 00007f6d`64489720 00007f6d`66d19632     libcoreclr!DispatchCallSimple+0xfe [/__w/1/s/src/coreclr/vm/callhelpers.cpp @ 220]

<p>尼玛，这一卦打的真离谱，怎么终结器线程在 <code>Sleep</code> 里？ 接下来根据 <code>!ip2md 00007f6cfea03ac9</code> 将代码导出来，截图如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/214741/202607/214741-20260720091520267-1212603011.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>啥？要暂停1h？这代码真的有点看不懂了，有知道的大牛看看这个逻辑咋样！</p>
<h2 id="三总结">三：总结</h2>
<p>这次生产事故的分析难度在我的旅程中还是蛮高的，它需要根据分析过程中的多个琐碎的碎片信息整理推理出完整的证据链，说实话没有多年的dump分析经验，这个问题真的很难搞定！</p>
<img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/cnblogs_com/huangxincheng/345039/o_210929020104最新消息优惠促销公众号关注二维码.jpg" width="700" height="300" alt="图片名称" align="center">
